routing_assumption.interpretation: Optimistic controlled upper-bound assumption. No claim of deployment feasibility or conservative movement-cost robustness is permitted.

ramp_evaluation.comparison: raw regional net demand versus regional net demand plus DC load
ramp_evaluation.interpretation: The primary objective penalizes high net-demand exposure, not the derivative of net demand. Add a ramp-aware objective only if the first v2 campaign worsens independently reported physical ramp KPIs.

attribution.interpretation: Ablations diagnose interacting mechanisms and are not additive causal decompositions. Lower-slope routing is a direct power-model consequence, not a novel RL discovery.

protocol.test_scope: full 8,928-step month on opposite four-cell fold

success_rule.savings: 95% optimizer-bootstrap CI lower bound is positive in both folds

protocol.interpretation: Cross-cell out-of-fold evaluation with 10 optimizer seeds per fold. Bootstrap intervals describe optimizer variability only; no population-level significance claim or cross-algorithm pairing.
